title: "simstim host alerts"

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Show where a host sends alerts about its sessions, and the last deliveries

## Synopsis

A host can tell you when a session needs you, finishes a long turn or fails, with the laptop shut.
It sends events to destinations you name: an ntfy topic, a webhook or a command on the host.
Nothing is sent until you name one. See docs/how-to/alerts.md.

```text
simstim host alerts <host> [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  simstim host alerts my-vps
  simstim host alerts set my-vps --ntfy https://ntfy.sh/<your-topic>
  simstim host alerts test my-vps
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for alerts
      --json   print JSON
```
